framings.text: A compounding, human-first experience where you can taste a coherent, durable, verified change that improves the whole codebase and makes future work easier.

supports.quote: a system that compounds itself and serves as a meta harness
not just the trees, but the forest.
I am the resterauntaur that tastes the final delicious product.

framings.text: A coordinated path that carries rough human intent through the agentic software lifecycle to a human-reviewable change, while checking codebase health along the way.

supports.quote: a human first board for coordinainting work from the entire continuum of agentic software development lifecycle
it goes from this part (the brain dump-the prompt-the hunch-the intuition) all the way to a PR that is ready to be reviewed by human

outcome: You experience software changes as delicious, trustworthy, whole-codebase improvements: your intent is understood, the result is coherent and durable, and the next change becomes easier.
misfits: The relationship between the desired compounding whole-system experience and the concrete lifecycle-coordination path is unresolved.

questions.text: Should the investigation primarily optimize for the compounding whole-codebase experience, the end-to-end coordination path, or their relationship?

alternatives.label: Human-tasting review loop
alternatives.benefit: Centers your judgment while progressively improving coherence, verification, and codebase health.
alternatives.cost: May require more human involvement and slower throughput.

alternatives.label: Lifecycle coordination workspace
alternatives.benefit: Makes the route from intuition to human-reviewable change explicit and easier to coordinate.
alternatives.cost: Could overemphasize workflow structure over the deeper compounding experience.
